testo:
■ Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your water, darkness or fire creatures. (If a card is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature.)
■ When you put this creature, you may put the top 3 cards of your deck into your graveyard.
■ Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a creature or tamaseed from your graveyard under this creature.

■ このクリーチャーが攻撃する時、クリーチャーかタマシードを1つ、自分の墓地からこのクリーチャーの下においてもよい。
